items.claim: Jovan Lecca can take people down, use ground and pound, and wrestle, not just strike.
items.quote: Lecca can take people down, too. You could just watch highlights of him knocking bums out and just think he's a striker. Lecca can knock people out and ground and pound and wrestle.

items.claim: Alexander Popic is significantly smaller than Jovan Lecca, facing a 60-pound weight disadvantage.
items.quote: Alexander Popic is way outsized by Joson Lecca. Joson Lecca is 6'5", 79-in reach, 265 lbs... 60 lbs, it's a big [ __ ] deal.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira throws much straighter punches, uses range better, and is faster to the target than Oban Elliott.
items.quote: Michael Oliveira, lot straighter of a shooter, knows how to use his range a little bit, faster to the target.

items.claim: Marcin Tybura has poor takedown defense and sloppy boxing.
items.quote: Marcin Tybura's takedown offense is not that good... He doesn't have power. He's sloppy with his boxing.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz suffers from inactivity, having fought only twice since 2023 without a win.
items.quote: Jan Błachowicz, two fights since 2023, since June of 20 July of 2023, he's had two fights. Neither of those were victories.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is much faster than Jan Blachowicz and will have the advantage at range.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling is going to be the one with the advantage at range. Navajo Sterling's much faster than Jan Błachowicz.
